RestoreTrustCache.note: manifest digest c60336928b421ded9f90a361e1dfc892eb0d8507 is neither the file sha1 (8b31f7ef...) nor its IM4P inner-payload sha1 (32a65c93...) — the digest semantics of Personalize=true components differ per component type and cannot be reproduced from the shipped bytes alone (no kbag in these IM4Ps; the personalization path is iBoot-side). Measured matches that DO hold: OS sha1 == manifest; StaticTrustCache sha1 == manifest; RestoreRamDisk sha1 == manifest; identity-5 DeviceTree digest a702dd51 == the file's own sha1 and the sidecar plist dtre.Digest; RestoreDeviceTree digest 3efb1706 == the sidecar's rdtr.Digest exactly. The RestoreTrustCache digest matches nothing in the shipped file or (per the 396-byte DeviceTree plist pattern) any sidecar — trustcache files ship without plists in this IPSW. Recorded for the later AMFI work: the personalization digest of a static trustcache is not derivable on the host.

hfs_image.shape: raw case-sensitive HFS+ volume, no partition map, no UDIF trailer (expanded via scripts/unixnu/udif.py Image), 'HX' at 0x400 — the same container shape Apple's own restore RAMDisk uses
hfs_image.not_byte_reproducible: HFS+ stamps volume UUID and fsevents; byte-identity is only claimed for the cpio artifact

hfs_image.boot_shape_note: XNU-4570 IOKitBSDInit builds /dev/md0 from the ADT RAMDisk range and mounts it as a filesystem (bsd_init); it never unpacks cpio.gz. root=md0 or rd=md0 mounts this HFS+ image; the cpio.gz is the portable repack source, not the boot payload. DarwinBoot additionally accepts DBRDISK1-packed input (zero-page packing) which halves nothing here but is the pipeline's existing sidecar format (drivers/DarwinBoot/Test/packed_ramdisk.py pack).

trustcache_audit.provenance_correlation: the 9 binaries covered by the static trustcache are exactly the 9 staged from the system volume (launchd, dyld, mount, mount_hfs, fsck, fsck_hfs, newfs_hfs, ps, df); the 49 dylib/framework files come from Apple's ramdisk and are covered only by the RESTORE ramdisk's trustcache (048-78047-096.dmg.trustcache), not the static one.
trustcache_audit.verdict: every staged Mach-O cdhash (SHA1, the iOS12 AMFI schema) is in the UNION of the two caches (neither: 0); the static cache alone covers only 9 of 58. The staged out/y35a/ios12-root/.trustcache is the static one (per the task's step 7). For the first RAMDisk boot the packager must supply the restore cache instead of, or alongside, the static one, otherwise AMFI kills 49 of the 58 Mach-Os at dlopen. This is a packaging-stage decision, recorded here as the single gotcha of the iOS12 root-staging pipeline.

deviations_from_task_brief: step 2: the System DMG is APFS, not HFS+; mount_apfs -o rdonly used instead of a partition carve.

step 4: dyld_shared_cache_arm64 is 1.27 GB and cannot fit the 110 MB budget; the staged closure instead follows Apple's own cacheless restore-ramdisk model (real dylib files).
